modules.title: 一次请求怎样通过 Provider 变成模型结果
Provider 和 Model 的区别

items.title: 用厨师来理解 Provider
items.text: 你想找厨师做一道菜：Model 是真正做菜的厨师，Provider 是提供厨师和服务的餐厅或平台，API 是你向餐厅下单的窗口，API Key 是证明你有权点餐的会员卡，Base URL 是餐厅的地址。所以，Provider 就是你通过谁来使用 AI 模型。

items.title: Provider 和 Model 在配置中分别表示什么
items.text: 配置 `provider: openai`、`model: gpt-5`，表示通过 OpenAI 使用 gpt-5；配置 `provider: deepseek`、`model: deepseek-chat`，表示通过 DeepSeek 使用 deepseek-chat。可以简单理解为：Provider 是“谁提供服务”，Model 是“具体使用哪个模型”。如果配置里的 Provider 写成 `openai-compatible`，通常只说明服务平台接受类似 OpenAI 的请求格式，并不代表请求一定发给 OpenAI；还要结合 Base URL、API Key 发放方和账单方判断真正的服务平台。

modules.title: 换 Provider 后，价格和体验也可能变化
modules.text: 即使选择同一个 Model，不同 Provider 的价格、速度、稳定性、上下文限制、图片或工具调用支持，以及数据处理规则也可能不同。排查配置时把四项放在一起看：Provider 是通过谁调用，Model 是选哪个模型，Base URL 是请求发到哪里，API Key 是使用谁签发的凭证。

lessonPractice.title: provider: OpenRouter，model: deepseek-v4-flash。请问我们连接的模型提供商是谁？

options.label: OpenRouter
options.feedback: 对。Provider 表示通过哪个服务平台调用，Model 表示这次选择的具体模型，所以这里连接的模型提供商是 OpenRouter。

options.label: deepseek-v4-flash
options.feedback: 这不是 Provider，而是 Model 名称。它说明选择了哪个模型，不能单独说明请求通过哪个服务平台发送。

options.label: 无法判断
options.feedback: 这里已经明确写出 `provider: OpenRouter`，因此可以判断请求通过 OpenRouter 发送。

en.title: provider: OpenRouter, model: deepseek-v4-flash. Who is the model provider we connect to?

options.label: OpenRouter
options.feedback: Correct. Provider says which service platform you call, while Model says which model you select. The provider here is OpenRouter.

options.label: deepseek-v4-flash
options.feedback: That is the Model name, not the Provider. It identifies which model is selected, not which service platform receives the request.

options.label: It cannot be determined
options.feedback: The configuration explicitly says `provider: OpenRouter`, so the request goes through OpenRouter.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请检查当前配置中的 Provider、Model、Base URL 和 API Key 来源是否相互对应。先说明请求实际发往哪里、凭证由谁发放、账单由谁收取；不要读取或打印真实 API Key，也不要修改配置。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Check whether the configured Provider, Model, Base URL, and API key source agree. First report where the request goes, who issued the credential, and who bills it; do not read or print the real API key or change the configuration.

learning.assumes: You have used an AI tool that returns an answer or code.
learning.outcome: You can use the Provider, Model, Base URL, and API key source in a configuration to identify who provides the service.

modules.title: How does one request pass through a Provider and become a model result?
How to tell a Provider from a Model

items.title: Use a chef to understand a Provider
items.text: Imagine you are looking for a chef to cook a dish: the Model is the chef who actually cooks, the Provider is the restaurant or platform that provides the chef and service, the API is the counter where you place an order, the API Key is the membership card that proves you are allowed to order, and the Base URL is the restaurant's address. So, the Provider is who you use to access an AI model.

items.title: What do Provider and Model mean in a configuration?
items.text: `provider: openai` with `model: gpt-5` means using gpt-5 through OpenAI. `provider: deepseek` with `model: deepseek-chat` means using deepseek-chat through DeepSeek. In short: the Provider is who supplies the service, and the Model is which model you select. If the configured Provider is `openai-compatible`, it usually means that the service platform accepts a request format similar to OpenAI. It does not prove that the request goes to OpenAI; check the Base URL, key issuer, and billing party to identify the actual service platform.

modules.title: Changing Providers can change price and experience
modules.text: Even with the same Model, Providers may differ in price, speed, stability, context limits, image or tool-call support, and data handling. Read four settings together: Provider is who you call through, Model is what you select, Base URL is where the request goes, and API key identifies the credential issuer.

distinctions.label: API Proxy
distinctions.text: A {c:provider} is the entity hosting model weights, inference compute, and billing; an {c:api-proxy} is an intermediary forwarding traffic between the client and provider.
